name: African Elephant
description: The African savanna elephant is the living terrestrial heavyweight: a multi-tonne bull armed with tusks, crushing mass and exceptional sensory intelligence.

name: African Lion

description: The African Lion is a powerful social big cat built for explosive close-range combat.

name: African Wild Dog
description: The African wild dog (Lycaon pictus) is a 25 kg cursorial hypercarnivore built around speed, stamina, slicing bite mechanics and extraordinary social cooperation.

name: Albatross
description: The wandering albatross is the ultimate endurance flier: a roughly 10 kg Southern Ocean seabird carrying the widest wings of any living bird.

name: Alligator
description: The American alligator is a heavily armored freshwater ambush predator built around one of the strongest directly measured bites in the living animal world.

name: Alpaca
description: The alpaca (Vicugna pacos) is a domesticated South American camelid built for life in the high Andes.

name: Anaconda
description: The green anaconda is a heavyweight semi-aquatic constrictor built to turn one close-range mistake into a crushing grapple.

name: Anglerfish

name: Anteater
description: The giant anteater (Myrmecophaga tridactyla) is a roughly 40 kg South American insect specialist with no teeth, a long sticky tongue and some of the most formidable foreclaws of any mammal its size.

name: Arctic Fox
description: The Arctic fox (Vulpes lagopus) is a small circumpolar canid built less for brute-force combat than for surviving and moving through one of Earth's harshest environments.

name: Arctic Wolf
description: The Arctic wolf is a 40 kg-class High Arctic gray wolf built around endurance, pack tactics and survival in extreme cold.

name: Armadillo
description: The armadillo is a small, heavily protected digging mammal whose real advantage is defense, not attack.

name: Army Ant
description: Burchell's army ant is a tiny but intensely specialized Neotropical predator.

name: Axolotl
description: The axolotl (Ambystoma mexicanum) is a small, fully aquatic Mexican salamander famous for retaining its juvenile gills throughout adulthood and for regenerating limbs and complex tissues.

name: Baboon

name: Bactrian Camel

name: Badger
description: The European badger is a compact 13 kg digging specialist built for close-range resistance rather than speed.

name: Bald Eagle
description: The Bald Eagle is a large North American sea eagle built around aerial control rather than brute force.

name: Barn Owl
description: The Barn Owl is a lightweight nocturnal raptor built for precision rather than brute force.

name: Barracuda

name: Beaver
description: The North American beaver is a 20-plus-kilogram semi-aquatic engineer armed with continuously growing, self-sharpening incisors and an exceptionally efficient gnawing bite.

name: Beluga Whale
description: The beluga is a 1.5-tonne Arctic toothed whale built less for raw predatory violence than for survival and sensory control in an icy three-dimensional world.

name: Bighorn Sheep

name: Bison
description: The American bison is North America's largest land mammal, a near-tonne bull built around enormous forequarter power, permanent horns and explosive speed.

name: Black Bear

name: Black Mamba

name: Black Rhinoceros

name: Black Widow

name: Boa Constrictor

name: Bobcat

name: Bongo

name: Bottlenose Dolphin

name: Box Jellyfish
description: The Australian box jellyfish is a physically fragile but biochemically extreme predator.

name: Bull Shark

name: Bullet Ant

name: Bullfrog

name: Cheetah

name: Chimpanzee

name: Cockatoo

description: The Secretary Bird is a long-legged African ground raptor built around precision impact rather than grappling.

name: Serval
description: The serval is a 14 kg African grassland cat built around acoustic precision and explosive vertical pouncing.

name: Shoebill
description: A towering African marsh predator built around patience rather than pursuit.

name: Siberian Tiger
description: The Amur tiger is a cold-adapted, solitary heavyweight cat built around stealth, explosive acceleration and close-range control.

name: Skunk
description: The striped skunk is a small North American omnivore whose modest physical combat power is transformed by one of the roster's strongest deterrent systems.

name: Sloth
description: The pale-throated three-toed sloth is a small, highly specialized rainforest canopy mammal built for secure suspension, camouflage and extreme energy conservation.

name: Sloth Bear
description: A shaggy South Asian bear specialized for termites but armed for a violent close-range defense.

name: Snapping Turtle
description: The common snapping turtle is a heavily built freshwater ambush predator whose real danger comes from a rapid long-necked beak strike backed by partial shell armor.

name: Snow Leopard
description: A 50 kg adult male snow leopard is a specialized mountain ambush cat built around claws, a throat bite, camouflage and extraordinary terrain control.

name: Snowy Owl
description: The Snowy Owl is a roughly 2.15 kg Arctic raptor whose real strengths are precision, senses and mobility rather than brute force.
